name: Mahoutsukai to Pandora no Yume
original_name: 魔法使いとパンドラの夢
source:
Once upon a time, there was a very bad wizard.
The bad wizard lived alone in a remote forest.

Despite living in such a secluded place, away from the public eye,
one day he received a letter.
It was from the royal palace.

After reading it, the wizard was astonished.
Then, he hurried to the royal palace.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4741]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
很久很久以前，有一个坏透了的魔法师。

坏魔法师独自住在偏远的森林里。

尽管住在这样与世隔绝、远离人烟的地方，

有一天，他还是收到了一封信。

那封信来自王宫。

读完信后，魔法师大吃一惊。

随后，他匆匆赶往王宫。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4741]NovelGame[/url]]
